# Codex Worklog Commentary

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/antigravity-codex-worklog.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/antigravity-codex-worklog)
[![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/lemonxiny55/antigravity-codex-worklog)](https://github.com/lemonxiny55/antigravity-codex-worklog/releases)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)

English | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

> **Stop watching your AI agent run 15 silent tool calls inside collapsed `Thought` blocks just to say "Done!"**  
> Bring OpenAI Codex-style live progress commentary and evidence-anchored engineering worklogs between tool batches to Google Antigravity — so you can verify facts live and steer mid-run.

<!-- TODO: Replace with recorded 20s demo -->
<!-- ![Codex Worklog Demo](./assets/demo.gif) -->

---

## Quick Start (10 Seconds)

```bash
npx antigravity-codex-worklog@latest
```

Restart Antigravity (or start a new session), then toggle **Codex Worklog Commentary** in **Skills & Customizations**.

---

## Before vs. After

**Without plugin (default silent chain):**
```text
[Collapsed Thought block]
> Ran 12 tools silently...
"Done! I updated the files and checked everything."
```

**With `codex-worklog` enabled (live interleaved evidence):**
```text
Initial Preamble:
I'll create an isolated worktree from origin/main for the documentation fix
without touching existing dirty media files, then verify link checks and CI.

> Ran 3 commands (git status, git worktree add, link check)

Updated both READMEs in the isolated worktree while leaving 4 unrelated local
changes untouched. Local check verified 76 internal links; 2 external URLs hit
timeouts and are being re-checked individually. Next, I'll verify the external
URLs and open the PR.

> Ran 2 commands (curl verify, gh pr create)

PR #18 created and CI is green on Node 22/24. No pending review comments remain.
```

> **Tip — Steering Mid-Execution**: Because every update previews the exact next step, if you see the agent heading in the wrong direction, simply send a message while it is still working. Antigravity queues your message and redirects immediately after the current tool call finishes.

---

## Why & Inspiration

In OpenAI's open-source [`openai/codex`](https://github.com/openai/codex) and [`openai/harmony`](https://github.com/openai/harmony) specifications, coding agents separate output into three distinct layers:

1. **Internal Reasoning (`analysis`)**: Hidden scratchpad thinking.
2. **Interleaved Commentary (`commentary` / `MessagePhase::Commentary`)**: Short, factual progress updates (`default.md` *Preamble messages*, `gpt_5_codex_prompt.md` *Sharing progress updates*) placed directly between grouped tool executions.
3. **Final Answer (`final_answer`)**: Clean delivery without dumping raw file contents (*Presenting your work*).

By default, Antigravity models tend to place intermediate notes into collapsible `Thought` blocks and execute long tool chains silently. **Codex Worklog Commentary v0.2.0** brings that open-source Codex commentary protocol into Antigravity's native plugin rule system, including guardrails against common failure modes like premature turn termination (`openai/codex#7900`) and Plan-to-Execution drift.

---

## Key Features (v0.2.0)

1. **Visible Channel Discipline**: Enforces writing progress updates into visible assistant message text alongside tool calls — never hidden solely inside `thought` blocks.
2. **Smart Cadence & Logical Batching**: Skips chatter on trivial Q&A or single reads; groups 1–4 related tool calls per batch and always sends a brief preamble before heavy or state-mutating operations.
3. **Evidence-Anchored 3-Part Micro-Cycle**: Every update covers concrete **Facts & Evidence** (counts, paths, exact errors, CI status), **Decision & Guardrail** (parameter tweaks, untouched files), and **Next Action Preview**.
4. **Anti-Premature-Termination Guardrail**: Prevents the `openai/codex#7900` failure pattern where an agent stops its turn right after outputting an interim status sentence.
5. **Plan-to-Execution Continuity**: Preserves interleaved commentary across Antigravity's dual-stage workflow (`exit_plan_mode` handoff from planning to execution).
6. **Language Mirroring & Dry Worklog Tone**: Automatically writes in the user's language (English, Chinese, etc.) with zero conversational filler and no full-file dumping at the end.

---

## Alternative Installation & Status Check

### Check `npx` Installation Status

```bash
npx antigravity-codex-worklog@latest status
```

### Install via `git clone`

Clone directly into your global Antigravity plugins directory (`~/.gemini/config/plugins/codex-worklog`):

#### Windows (PowerShell)

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/lemonxiny55/antigravity-codex-worklog.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\codex-worklog"
```

#### macOS / Linux

```bash
git clone https://github.com/lemonxiny55/antigravity-codex-worklog.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/codex-worklog
```

### Activation

1. Restart Antigravity (or reload the agent service / start a new session) so the plugin rules are discovered.
2. Open **Skills & Customizations** in the sidebar to confirm **Codex Worklog Commentary** is enabled. You can toggle it on or off globally anytime without deleting files.

---

## Updating & Uninstalling

### Update

```bash
# Via npx
npx antigravity-codex-worklog@latest update
```

```powershell
# Or via git (Windows PowerShell)
git -C "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\codex-worklog" pull
```

```bash
# Or via git (macOS / Linux)
git -C ~/.gemini/config/plugins/codex-worklog pull
```

### Uninstall

```bash
# Via npx
npx antigravity-codex-worklog@latest uninstall
```

```powershell
# Or manually (Windows PowerShell)
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\codex-worklog"
```

```bash
# Or manually (macOS / Linux)
rm -rf ~/.gemini/config/plugins/codex-worklog
```

## 10 秒快速上手

```bash
npx antigravity-codex-worklog@latest
```

重启 Antigravity（或新开会话），即可在左侧 **Skills & Customizations** 面板随时开启或关闭 **Codex Worklog Commentary**。

---

## 装完前后对比（Before / After）

**没装插件前（默认静默工具链）：**
```text
[折叠的 Thought 思考块]
> 静默连续调用了 12 个工具...
“已经帮你改好了，测试也看过了，没有问题！”
```

**装上 `codex-worklog` 后（实时穿插证据日志）：**
```text
开局宣告：
我会从最新 origin/main 创建独立文档工作树处理本次修改，不触碰原仓库既有未提交改动，完成后核验站内链接与 CI 状态。

> 运行了 3 个命令（git status、git worktree add、链接校验）

独立工作树已创建，未改动原仓库 4 项本地修改。76 个站内链接已完成本地核验，另有 2 个外链连接超时正在单独复查。下一步我将补测外链并创建 PR。

> 运行了 2 个命令（curl 复查、gh pr create）

文档 PR #18 已创建，Node 22/24 CI 均通过，当前无待处理审查意见。
```

> **中途纠偏技巧**：由于每段汇报都会明确写明**下一步动作预告**，一旦发现它准备改错文件或方向跑偏，无需先点停止，直接在底部输入框发消息告诉它如何调整。Antigravity 会在当前命令刚结束时立即拦截原路线并按你的新指示转向。

---

## 设计灵感与原理

参考 OpenAI 开源项目 [`openai/codex`](https://github.com/openai/codex) 与 [`openai/harmony`](https://github.com/openai/harmony) 的公开规范，Codex 之所以透明可控，源于它把输出切分为三层：

1. **内部思考（`analysis`）**：底层草稿推演，隐藏在折叠区中。
2. **穿插解说（`commentary` / `MessagePhase::Commentary`）**：在 `default.md`（*Preamble messages*）与 `gpt_5_codex_prompt.md`（*Sharing progress updates*）中定义的阶段性进展汇报，穿插于工具执行卡片之间。
3. **最终交付（`final_answer`）**：结论与路径索引直接交付，避免把整段文件源码倾倒进对话（*Presenting your work*）。

Antigravity 默认提示词偏向“静默连续调用工具 + 隐藏思考块 + 末尾统一总结”。**Codex Worklog Commentary v0.2.0** 借鉴 `openai/codex` 开源提示词工程与真实避坑经验（如 `openai/codex#7900` 防早停护栏），在 Antigravity 全局插件层完整复刻了这一体验。

---

## 核心特性（v0.2.0）

1. **可见通道硬约束**：强制要求把阶段汇报写入面向用户的**可见正文**，禁止只写进隐藏 `Thought` 思考块导致工具卡片之间一片空白。
2. **智能节奏与逻辑分组**：简单问答或单次轻量读文件不刷屏；多步任务按 1~4 个关联工具为一组穿插 1~3 句汇报，且在大改动、全量测试、构建或推送前必发前置预告。
3. **三段式证据锚点微循环**：每段汇报固定覆盖 **事实与证据**（精确计数、路径、报错原文、CI 状态）、**决策与风控边界**（参数调整依据、未触碰无关文件确认）与 **下一步动作预告**。
4. **防提前结束回合护栏**：规避 `openai/codex#7900` 典型坑——严禁在刚输出“接下来我将……”后未附带工具调用就提前结束回合。
5. **Plan / Execute 双阶段穿透**：兼容 Antigravity 的 `exit_plan_mode` 规划-执行双模型切换，确保进入实际改代码阶段后仍保持穿插汇报。
6. **自动语言镜像与工单口吻**：规则内核采用高指令遵循度的英文编写，输出语言自动跟随用户（中文提问即输出干练中文工程日志），去除客套寒暄且不在最终回复倾倒整文件正文。

---

## 其他安装与状态查看

### 查看 `npx` 安装状态与完整性

```bash
npx antigravity-codex-worklog@latest status
```

### 通过 `git clone` 手动安装

将仓库直接克隆到 Antigravity 全局插件目录（`~/.gemini/config/plugins/codex-worklog`）：

#### Windows (PowerShell)

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/lemonxiny55/antigravity-codex-worklog.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\codex-worklog"
```

#### macOS / Linux

```bash
git clone https://github.com/lemonxiny55/antigravity-codex-worklog.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/codex-worklog
```

### 启用生效

1. 重启 Antigravity（或重载服务端后新开会话），系统会自动发现并加载该全局插件。
2. 在左侧 **Skills & Customizations** 面板中找到 **Codex Worklog Commentary**，可随时一键开启或关闭，无需手动删文件。
